_about: Discovery partitions (devops/discovery_plan.py). One lane per job site, never mixed. partitions: how many independent machines read that site's boards; max_partitions: the most it may ever be split into; budget: the most boards of that site read at the same moment across ALL its partitions (one_host sites: machines asking the one host at once, each keeping the 1.5 s gap). lane "mac": the site is read on the Mac, outside the cloud fetch (its boards are still counted in the coverage, as planned on the Mac). quota: the most of the site's boards one cloud run asks, the least recently read first, so every board takes its turn; the rest are deferred by quota, never called failed. A site not listed gets one partition.
_history: Nov 2026, owner-approved: Greenhouse 3, Lever 2, Ashby 2 machines, one board at a time each (about 1.6, 1.1 and 1.1 requests a second to each host in all, watched for 429s, each machine backing off on its own); Workday read on the Mac (refused on GitHub nearly every time, not on the Mac); Workable and Jobvite on a quota (Workable refused nearly every request from both).
